title: search-api p95 elevated across all regions
text: Opened by on-call (Priya Raman) at 09:12 UTC after the SLO burn alert fired. search-api p95 latency climbed from ~180 ms to ~640 ms starting early Sept 14 and is holding there. p50 is only slightly up. Error rate is flat, so requests succeed but slowly. CPU on the search-api pods is up ~35%. Checked the CDN and the edge cache: both look normal. No config pushes in the last 12 hours. Mitigation so far: scaled search-api from 24 to 36 pods, which took p95 down to ~520 ms but did not clear it. Root cause: not yet identified. Leaving open for the search team to investigate on Monday. Customer impact: slower search results pages, some timeouts on the mobile app's type-ahead.

title: Search results slow for EU shoppers
text: Customers in the EU reported slow search pages from 14:00 UTC. search-api p95 latency rose to ~900 ms for EU traffic only. Traced to a CDN configuration change that removed the regional cache rule for /search, so every request went to origin. Rolled back the CDN change at 15:40 UTC and p95 returned to normal within 10 minutes. Root cause: CDN config change (change ticket CHG-2231). Follow-up: add the cache rule to the CDN config tests.

title: checkout-api 5xx errors on order submit
text: From 10:20 UTC about 4% of order submits return HTTP 502 from checkout-api. Retries usually succeed. The errors come from the tax calculation step, which times out after 2 s. The tax provider's status page shows no problems. Mitigated by raising the tax timeout to 5 s at 11:05; errors dropped to 1%. Root cause not found yet, handing to the payments team.

title: catalog-svc indexing lag
text: New and updated products take up to 3 hours to appear in search, normally under 10 minutes. The catalog-svc indexing queue has 1.2M messages backed up. Workers are healthy but each batch is slow. Added 8 more workers as a stopgap. Cause under investigation.

title: Homepage recommendation carousel empty
text: The 'Picked for you' carousel on the homepage renders empty for logged-in users since about 08:00 UTC. recs-api returns 200 with an empty list. Logged-out users still see the popular-items fallback. Revenue from the carousel is down ~60% today.

title: Login failures on web and app
text: All logins failed between 13:02 and 13:48 UTC with 'invalid token signature'. auth-gateway rejected tokens signed with the new key because the new public key had not reached the verifier pods. Recovered by following the certificate rotation runbook (re-publish the JWKS, restart verifiers). Root cause: the key rotation was deployed before the JWKS publish step.

title: Type-ahead suggestions out of date
text: Search type-ahead still suggests products that were removed from the catalog last week. The suggestion index rebuild job on search-api has been failing quietly since Sept 19 because its service account lost read access to the catalog bucket. Access restored and rebuild re-run.

title: Image thumbnails missing on PDP
text: Product detail pages showed grey boxes instead of thumbnails for about 20 minutes. The image resizer ran out of disk. Cleared the temp folder and added a disk alert.

title: Promo codes rejected at checkout
text: Codes from the summer email campaign were rejected as expired. The campaign was created with the wrong end date. Marketing fixed the date; no code change.

title: Order confirmation emails delayed
text: Confirmation emails arrived up to 2 hours late. The email vendor throttled us after a bounce spike. Vendor lifted the limit.

title: Store locator map blank in Safari
text: The store locator showed a blank map in Safari 18 after a maps SDK update. Pinned the SDK to the previous version.

title: Inventory counts wrong for two warehouses
text: Stock levels for the Reno and Dayton warehouses were doubled for 3 hours after a sync job ran twice. De-duplicated the sync records.

title: recs-api slow responses during sale
text: recs-api p95 latency reached 1.4 s during the flash sale start. Feature store reads were the bottleneck. Added a read replica.

title: Gift card balance check failing
text: Balance checks returned errors for 15 minutes due to an expired TLS certificate on the gift card provider connection. Renewed the certificate.

title: Duplicate push notifications
text: Some app users got the same push notification three times. A retry loop in notify-svc did not check for success. Fixed the retry check.

title: Search filters missing for Home category
text: Filters for the Home category disappeared after a taxonomy import dropped the facet config. Re-imported the facet config.

title: Cart totals off by tax rounding
text: Some carts showed totals one cent higher than the receipt. Rounding was applied per line instead of per order. Fixed the rounding order.

title: Admin portal login loop
text: Store managers could not log in to the admin portal; the page reloaded in a loop. A cookie SameSite setting changed in auth-gateway. Reverted the setting.

title: Payment provider outage
text: The card payment provider had an outage for 50 minutes. checkout-api p95 latency spiked and many orders failed. Switched to the backup provider after 20 minutes.

title: Wishlist sync failing on Android
text: Android app users could not sync wishlists. A required API field was renamed. Added the old field name back.

title: Catalog bucket permission audit
text: Security audit found two service accounts with write access to the catalog bucket that only need read access. Removed the extra access.

title: Recommendations email links broken
text: Links in the weekly recommendations email pointed to a staging host. Template variable fixed and email re-sent.

title: Store pickup slots not showing
text: Customers could not pick a pickup slot for stores in Texas. A timezone bug in the slot service. Fixed and backfilled.

title: auth-gateway elevated latency
text: auth-gateway p95 latency doubled to 220 ms for an hour because of a noisy neighbour on the shared Redis. Moved session reads to the dedicated cluster.

title: Size guide pages 404
text: Size guide links returned 404 after the CMS migration. Redirects added.

title: Returns label generation failing
text: Return labels failed to generate for Canadian addresses. The carrier changed its postal code format check. Updated the formatter.
